sandbox: static copy of the parity-baseline public/ assets; no manager process was started
backend: fetch replayed from fixtures/http raw bytes; io() stubbed (tests/L2-ui/helpers/mocks.js)
note: Every value is either read out of a browser running the parity-baseline UI or is the raw recorded fixture bytes that page was fed. Nothing is derived from the SPEC pack or from the candidate. tools/parity/gen-goldens.js composes the resave golden family from these inputs using the baseline slices pinned by tools/parity/baseline-slices.js, and cross-checks its output against the storage_after / argv / dialog bytes the baseline produced in the same sessions.
